title: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking & Security — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Maps Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking: establishes global VPC boundaries, multi-region subnets, Cloud NAT gateways, and Cloud Router dynamic BGP.
routing_rationale: Google Cloud VPCs are global resources spanning all regions. Subnets are regional, allowing compute instances across the globe to communicate privately without public IPs.

nodes.label: External SaaS API
nodes.detail: External vendor endpoint requiring outbound HTTPS connectivity over public internet.

nodes.label: Cloud NAT Gateway
nodes.detail: Performs source network address translation for private RFC 1918 instances.

nodes.label: Private Compute VM (US)
nodes.detail: Compute Engine instance processing local order transactions.

nodes.label: Cloud Router (BGP)
nodes.detail: Exchanges dynamic routes and provides the routing control path used by Cloud NAT.

nodes.label: Private Database VM (EU)
nodes.detail: Private VM communicating directly with US VM over Google private fiber without public IPs.

steps.title: Outbound NAT Egress
steps.action: Private VM calls SaaS API; Cloud NAT translates 10.1.0.5:54321 to public IP 35.190.20.10:1024.
steps.why_traversal: Private VMs communicate with internet APIs without exposing inbound listening ports.

steps.title: Global Private Routing
steps.action: US VM communicates directly with EU VM across Google's private Andromeda SDN backbone.
steps.why_traversal: Global VPC routing eliminates VPN tunnels or public internet transit between regions.

steps.title: Dynamic Port Scaling
steps.action: Cloud NAT dynamically allocates additional port blocks to VM as connection count rises.
steps.why_traversal: Dynamic Port Allocation prevents packet drops during outbound connection spikes.

scenarios.label: Cloud NAT Port Pool Exhaustion
scenarios.root_cause: VM initiated 10,000 concurrent outbound connections; static port allocation ran out of ports.
scenarios.diverted_path: New outbound TCP handshakes dropped; external SaaS calls time out.
scenarios.blast_radius: Only outbound SaaS calls from this VM fail; intra-VPC traffic to EU VM continues normally.
scenarios.recovery: Enable Dynamic Port Allocation on Cloud NAT and assign secondary NAT IP addresses.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Maps Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking: establishes global VPC boundaries, multi-region subnets, Cloud NAT gateways, and Cloud Router dynamic BGP.
